title: 91. How do I change the general look and feel of my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I change the general look and feel of my survey.
short_answer: Open your survey, go to the 'Properties' page and select 'Appearance' section. Choose a new survey skin from the available skins under 'Skin' using the drop- down menu. Click on 'Save'. If you have already published your survey, please remember to go to the 'Overview' page and click on 'Apply Changes'.
